# Perpetually in Transit

> > A lifestyle and travel blog exploring South Asian culture, Korean dramas, personal growth, and authentic living through the lens of perpetual movement.

Perpetually in Transit (YOTRIPP) is Sayali's multi-topic blog covering travel across India, South East Asia, and Africa, alongside cultural commentary, K-drama reviews, wellness tips, and reflections on feminism and authenticity in the digital age.

## Key Topics

- Travel blogging
- South Asian culture
- K-drama reviews
- Women's empowerment
- Authentic living
- Indian destinations
- Folk art and crafts
- Social media authenticity
- Wellness and fitness
- Digital nomad lifestyle
- Cultural heritage
- Netflix content
- Bangladesh crafts
- Personal reflection
- Feminism

## About & Home

- [Home](https://perpetuallyintransit.com/home): YOTRIPP travel blog covering India, South East Asia, and Africa destinations
- [About Me](https://perpetuallyintransit.com/sample-page): About Sayali: multi-topic lifestyle blogger covering travel and parenting

## Culture & Heritage

- [India: Where Citizens Get Murdered And Murderers Walk Scot Free!](https://perpetuallyintransit.com/india-where-citizens-get-murdered-and-murderers-walk-scot-free): Social commentary on marine pollution and wildlife deaths on India's coast
- [Kulithacha Pitla or Vegan Horse Gram Flour Soup](https://perpetuallyintransit.com/kulithacha-pithla-marathi-or-vegan-horse-gram-flour-soup): Vegan Maharashtrian horse gram soup recipe with Ayurvedic benefits
